hypothesis: Task-driven spatial reconstruction and an adaptive recurrent activation regime make actual spike history useful beyond gate amplitude for object grouping.

arms.legacy_full: Inherited whole SW0097 source; classifier consumes actual component spikes.
arms.adaptive_full: Only eligible new candidate: inherited source with retention initialized .9 and calibrated adaptive event threshold; classifier consumes actual component spikes.
arms.gate_only_control: Counterfactual control: recorded actual scalar gate repeated over four channels; same classifier/decoder; never eligible as final model.

source.checkpoint: SW0097 same-seed positive_frozen whole core plus registered shared encoder/preprocessing
source.initial_upstream_identity: graph, theta and raw gate identical across arms before learning; candidate downstream traces intentionally differ
source.legacy_defaults: unchanged; strict-load original source before attaching opt-in modules

calibration.data: first four original ordered TRAIN B16 batches per seed; 64 images; no GT
calibration.source: unchanged legacy source and original registered encoder
calibration.kappa_guard: all finite and strictly positive; fail without tuning otherwise
calibration.kappa_target: coarse submaximal duty-cycle regime; not an exact firing-rate constraint or object-count target
calibration.rms: legacy actual spike RMS per component pooled over same64images,256patches,32frames; values<=1e-8 replaced by1; identical frozen4-value buffer for all arms
calibration.provenance: bind ordered image IDs/cache rows, source/encoder/preprocessing/cache/code SHAs, and calibration buffer hashes

adaptive_neuron.retention_initialization: all existing tau_n and tau_m set to logit(.9); remain trainable
adaptive_neuron.adaptation_state: a and previous binary event reset to zero each rollout; not checkpoint state
adaptive_neuron.actual_spike: e*g; previous actual weighted spike still feeds dendrite
adaptive_neuron.fold: row b*4+d; expand component buffers through [B,4,N] then flatten to[B*4,N]
adaptive_neuron.surrogate: existing ActFun_adp; do not detach activation ancestors, reset or adaptation recurrence

activity_guards.scope: each component on first4 TRAIN batches, settled32 frames, both before training and after final training
activity_guards.failure: any failing adaptive component/seed ends recipe; no recalibration or seed exclusion

classifier.input: actual [B,4,256,Tsettled] spikes for full arms; recorded gate repeated4channels for counterfactual control; shared legacy RMS
classifier.temporal_encoder: per patch Conv1d4->32,k5,pad2,GELU; Conv1d32->64,k5,pad2,GELU; temporal mean pooling
classifier.failure_mode: fixed11 logits can learn global color categories and merge same-appearance objects

decoder.input: only live64D spike-derived slot latent plus normalized2D patch-center coordinate
decoder.output: each slot's RGB8x8 patch for each of256patches; reconstruct by P-weighted mixing
decoder.loss: per-image full128x128 RGB MSE / detached max(mean_channel(var_over_pixels(RGB)),1e-6), then batch mean
decoder.posttraining_assignment_credit_check: fixed row permutation seed12301 of P while holding slot latents/decoded patches fixed must increase mean reconstruction error on first4TRAIN batches

schedule.training_ids: same seed's exact original ordered4096TRAIN IDs; shuffle117/118/119
schedule.warmup: 32B16 batches on first512orderedTRAIN images; source/core/encoder/newthreshold frozen; head+decoder Adam3e-4 clip1; preserve optimizer state
schedule.optimizers: fresh core/graph/encoder Adam; continued warm head/decoder Adam; both optimize same reconstruction objective
schedule.clip_norm: separate1 over core/graph/encoder/newthreshold and1 over head/decoder
schedule.preflight: first4TRAIN finite loss and active expected gradient families; real disposable B16twoAdam update; independent deep-copied warm optimizer; exact foldedlayout and actual B16memory check before fanout
schedule.gate_only_gradient_exception: unused dendrite/membrane branches need not receive gradient and must remain unchanged
schedule.artifacts: create-once; all model/buffer/optimizer/history SHAs;256updates; completion marker last

evaluation.fixed_metric_contract: same dataset/preprocessing, IDs1320-1639, modal16x16GT, ordinary FG-ARI/foreground-IoU/matched-object-IoU; no prediction-dependent allowed-label diagnostic
evaluation.gamma: regenerated from actual trained encoder and registered frozen preprocessing on native RGB
evaluation.new_primary_readout: argmax(P); largest predicted slot BG, equal-area tie by first occupied patch index; foreground slots with<2patches becomeBG; no spatial splitting or object count
evaluation.secondary_readout: unchanged actualQ>=.50/min2/largest-component QCC, explicitly separate from primary

pilot_gates.paired_bootstrap: 10000draws,seed123,common sampled image indices across fixed3seeds;95%lower bound positive against each reference
pilot_gates.failure: end recipe without coefficient/threshold tuning or seed selection; no70k launch from this artifact

conditional_scientific_followup.stage_tests: after positive pilot preregister full320frozen coupling/gate/dendrite-retention/membrane-retention/event interventions and temporal-shuffle readout; retain fitted calibration; paired endpoint evidence; matched retrained ablations before learning-contribution claims
conditional_scientific_followup.all_stage_claim: unmet if downstream stages remain dispensable even when masks improve
conditional_scientific_followup.scale: only after positive model/stage evidence: common registered initialization, nested2500/10000/70000TRAIN subsets with70000draws/4375B16updates each; disclose inherited pretraining/warmup data; distinguish unique-data from extra-update effects
conditional_scientific_followup.existing_SW0109: independent legacy scaling evidence; recover/evaluate without conflating with new branch

limits: Adaptive arm bundles retention restoration and adaptive event selection; pilot cannot isolate those changes.
New classifier is allowed; fixed dataset/GT/metrics are unchanged. Do not describe this as the old QCC recipe improving.
Gradient existence, activation variation or shuffled reconstruction sensitivity alone do not prove useful gates or object semantics.
This registration does not authorize implementation/deployment/training by itself.
